title: EP 28 — OUTPUT STYLES
sub: Change how Claude responds, not what it knows
lines: Output styles rewrite the system prompt
Output styles rewrite Clawd Code's system prompt — its role, tone, and output format, not what it knows.
Built in: Default, Proactive, Explanatory, Learning
Four built in: Default, Proactive that acts first, Explanatory that adds Insights, and Learning that leaves you TODO-human markers.
Set it in /config or the outputStyle setting
Pick one from slash config under Output style — it saves outputStyle to settings dot local dot json.
It loads at session start, not mid-turn
It's part of the system prompt, read once at session start, so a change takes effect after slash clear or a fresh session.
Write your own as a Markdown file in .claude/output-styles
Write a custom one: a Markdown file in dot-claude slash output-styles, with keep-coding-instructions to keep the engineering behavior.

Follow for a fresh Clawd Code tip every day.
